title: Optimizing Price Menus for Duration Discounts: A Subscription Selectivity Field Experiment
eligible_reason: Randomized price-menu field experiment for subscription duration discounts analyzed with a Bayesian selectivity multinomial probit (Stan). Cross-sectional user-level choices, no DiD.
design_notes: run_bsmnp.R loads user-level opt-in (Ys) and contract choice (Yo) with assigned menu prices and masked geodemographics and fits bsmnp.stan.
data_files_note: readme.txt names bsmnp_data_synthetic.csv (N = 18,286 masked users, masked covariates); a second file bsmnp_data_masked.csv is also present.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
